c01-card-0.observed_description: At a community-center registration desk a man with short brown hair and a light-blue shirt faces the camera, smiling, and holds up a bright-green card with the large white numeral 0 in both hands at chest height; a staff member sits at the counter behind, softly blurred. The card shows only 0; no other readable writing.
c01-card-0.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the man and the whole card stay inside the crop and the zero reads at 180 px.

c02-phone-0142.observed_description: Ana (long wavy black hair, olive-green shirt over a white top) stands on the left, smiling at the camera, and holds up a smartphone on the right whose white screen shows a small green telephone icon and the number 555-0142 in large black digits. No name or other writing.
c02-phone-0142.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the digits 555-0142 read at 250 px and are small but legible at 180 px.

c05-house-12.observed_description: On the left the front of a pale two-storey house with a blue front door and, beside the door, a white plate with the house number 12 in black numerals; in front a sidewalk and an empty street, and on the right, across the street, a green park with lawns, trees and a path. No people, cars, signs or other writing.
c05-house-12.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the house, its number 12, the street and the park read at 250 px; the number is small at 180 px.

c08-ask-phone.observed_description: A young man in a navy T-shirt points at the smartphone in his hand while he talks to a young woman in an olive shirt who takes a phone from her jeans pocket, in a bright room.
c08-ask-phone.note: Rejected: neither person looks like Luis or Ana (different faces and ages), so the cast is not recognisable. Not installed; the photo is remade as an edit of the address-question photo in a new revision.

c09-ask-address.observed_description: In a bright room Luis (short dark hair, navy T-shirt) holds a blank white envelope and a pen ready to write and asks Ana a question, eyebrows raised and mouth open; Ana (long wavy black hair, olive-green shirt over a white top) stands on the right and listens with a smile. Two people; the envelope is blank; no writing.
c09-ask-address.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): Luis asking with the envelope and pen reads at 180 px. Luis looks a little older than in his 3.x photos.
